anomalies.observed: R62 is listed with value '10' (ohms) in the netlist and SPICE deck.
anomalies.expected: R62 should be 10kΩ, as indicated by its MPN 0603WAF1002T5E (10k) and its role as a pull-up on U15's output; R61 and R63 in the same e-stop chain are 10K.

evidence.quote: R62 | 10 | Resistor_SMD:R_0603_1608Metric | MotorController:TAYLOR_RESISTOR |  | LCSC=C25804, MPN= 0603WAF1002T5E, Manufacturer=UNI-ROYAL(Uniroyal Elec)

anomalies.impact: A 10Ω pull-up to 3.3V on U15's output will prevent U15 from pulling the node low and may damage the buffer, breaking the e-stop chain.

anomalies.observed: The isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 have both GND1 (logic side) and GND2 (bus side) connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: For isolated CAN buses as stated in the spec, GND1 and GND2 should be on separate grounds (logic ground and isolated bus ground).

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) ... U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in) ...
two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver (`U11`/companion)

anomalies.impact: Galvanic isolation between the logic and CAN bus sides is defeated, allowing ground loops and eliminating the protective isolation.

anomalies.observed: D30's second LED anode (pin 4) is on ESTOP_OUT, and its cathode (pin 2) connects through R60 to ESTOP_OUT as well (R60.2 on ESTOP_OUT).
anomalies.expected: The cathode resistor R60 should connect to GND, so the LED lights when ESTOP_OUT is high.
anomalies.impact: D30's second LED is shorted and will never illuminate, so the e-stop status indication is lost.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple anomalies: R62 is a 10Ω pull-up instead of 10kΩ, the isolated CAN transceivers have their grounds tied together, and the D30 status LED is shorted.
